Northwind Controls — XR Series Controllers Technical Data
Publication XR-TD001C

Controller selection
XR series controllers: XR-8100 (2 MB user memory), XR-8200 (4 MB user memory),
XR-8300 (8 MB user memory). Conformal-coated variants carry the -K suffix and
extended-temperature variants carry the -XT suffix; both are separately orderable
parts with their own environmental ratings.

Each controller ships with a removable terminal block and requires a compatible
power supply from the same series.
